description: Statistical Tables of 10 Metro lines of Nanjing, China is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Xiaoyan Gu. These data are currently 10 lines and corresponding stations of Nanjing Metro. Among them, the first column in the table is the operation line, with 26 transfer stations and terminal stations in the middle(as of June 2019).These data were collected from the official network of Nanjing Metro. The official network of Nanjing Metro: {http://www.njmetro.com.cn/njdtweb/home/go-operate-center.do?tag=yyfw}. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
